note: Rewritten from Chhotani (1997), entry 104 (p. 36); the alate is recorded as Unknown in the original, so only the soldier and the worker are given; synonymy and literature are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow; antennae, labrum, legs and body nearly white. Head sparsely hairy, body more densely so. Body length 4.2. Head capsule subrectangular (length to mandible base 1.87, width 1.05). Fontanelle indistinct; eyes and ocelli absent. Labrum subtriangular, apical margin slightly concave or incurved. Postclypeus flat, with a few hairs; anteclypeus short, band-like, hairless. Mandibles short and stout, broad at the base (length 0.73). Left mandible with a small obtuse tooth at the anterior 1/4; right mandible with a small pointed tooth at the anterior 1/3. Postmentum long, club-shaped (length 1.12, maximum width 0.30, waist width 0.18), the waist below the middle. Pronotum length 0.30, width 0.60.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule, postclypeus and antennae pale yellow; abdomen greyish from the gut contents, tergites and sternites transparent. Head fairly densely hairy, body densely hairy. Body length 3.0–3.20. Head subcircular, length to mandible base 0.67–0.70, maximum width 0.83. Fontanelle round and small, diameter 0.07. Eyes and ocelli absent. Antennae 14-segmented. Postclypeus length 0.20, width 0.40–0.41. Labrum broad, ligulate (length 0.23–0.25, width 0.30–0.32). Pronotum length 0.17, width 0.40–0.43.
